subject.title: fix: tighten findSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer with execution guard

question: Should the session find tool now reject all fractional `limit` values as an intentional model-facing compatibility change?
rationale: The patch deliberately narrows an accepted tool-schema input type; deciding whether existing model/tool callers may rely on fractional normalization requires current-main contract and owner judgment.

options.title: Accept integer-only limits
options.body: Keep the schema and guard after rebase if current callers and sibling tool behavior confirm fractional limits have no supported meaning.

options.title: Preserve fractional compatibility
options.body: Keep the existing number schema and document or normalize the historical fractional behavior if compatibility is more important than strict validation.

recommendation.title: Accept integer-only limits
recommendation.body: Keep the schema and guard after rebase if current callers and sibling tool behavior confirm fractional limits have no supported meaning.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership could not be established without the required history inspection.
